description: Read the internal link neighbourhood of one page from the latest audit crawl snapshot: inlink and outlink counts with up to 20 example URLs each, crawl depth, URL template cluster, and whether the page is an orphan. Use it before recommending internal links or judging whether a page is reachable; a page that is not in the snapshot is reported with inSnapshot=false rather than an error. The result carries the snapshot coverage (crawled pages, sitemap URLs, truncated) so a partial crawl is never read as the whole site. Requires the audit:read scope.

url.description: Page URL or path on the site's domain

name: get_page_links
title: Read internal links for one page
